main_text.l: transit per regiones ⌣Affem[?], id est Syria, vbi ciui-tates sunt ⌣Albar[?], Sulmina, Hummis, Damascus, Sur[?], id est Tyrus, Acim, Tabaria, Cafaria, Amsurf[?], Beit almacdis, hoc est domus sanctificationis, sine Ierusalem, ⌣Alaramti[?], Ascalon, Gaza, Modian & Alkusim[?]: deinde secat inferiora terra Aegypti, vbi vrbes sunt Alforme, Canis, Damiat, Fizarat Aegypti, Alphanun & Alexandria: deinde transit per regiones Barcha, postea per regiones Africa, vbi est ciuitas Alkaharuez: tandem peruenit ad mare occidentale.

Quartū clima incipit a parte orientis, & transit per regiones Achebit, deinde per Coraffen & sunt ibi ciuitates Maforia, Afmisema[?], Fragana, Samarcant, Belha, Bochera, Haraba, Hamquena, Magudur, Astrien[?], Saras, Idus, Nisabor, Iurgen, Comis, Cabastren, Dabendimech, Gorduben, Deilen, Arci, Ispatlim, Kem, Heden, Neden, Atenaz[?], Huba, Senroz, Saram, Oce, Almosil, Calbet, Nasabin[?], Euit, Caput fontis, Calicale, Sunzat[?], Hara, Arechah & Kar-kesie: postea transit per partem septentrionalem regionis Affem, id est Syria, vbi ciuitates sunt Belis, Manbet, Ifmisar, Malchana, Zacara, Habeb, Canfirim, An-tiochia, Tripolis, Almafisa[?], Faica, Ecclesia magna, Ozma, Tarsus, Amudia: deinde venit ad mare Affem, id est Syriacu, vbi insulae sunt Cyprus & Rhodus: tandem vergit versus occidentem & transit regione Tange, donec peruenit ad mare occidentale.

page.notes: The scan is cut at the right edge; the ends of some lines on the right may be incomplete. Words marked [?] are doubtful readings of names and marks (the ⌣ mark before Affem, Albar, Alaramti is printed as a special sign). The catchword is read as "Quin" with a flourish and is uncertain.
